To clean air vents you need a screwdriver, a vacuum cleaner and a damp cloth.
Cleaning air vents takes 30 to 40 minutes.
Step 1 of clean air vents: unscrew the vent cover with the screwdriver.
Step 2 of clean air vents: vacuum the vent grille to remove the dust.
While step 2 runs, step 3 of clean air vents: wipe the vent cover with the damp cloth.
Step 4 of clean air vents: let the vent cover dry completely.
Step 5 of clean air vents: screw the vent cover back on with the screwdriver.

To clean a coffee maker you need white vinegar, water, a cloth and a coffee maker.
Cleaning a coffee maker takes 30 to 40 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a coffee maker: pour 1 cup of white vinegar into the coffee maker.
Step 2 of cleaning a coffee maker: brew a full cycle and let it run for 15 to 20 minutes.
Step 3 of cleaning a coffee maker: rinse the coffee maker by brewing plain water through it for 15 to 20 minutes.
While step 2 runs, step 4 of cleaning a coffee maker: wipe the outside of the coffee maker with a damp cloth.

To clean a light fixture you need a stepladder, soapy water and a cloth.
Cleaning a light fixture takes 20 to 30 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a light fixture: switch off the light at the wall switch.
Step 2 of cleaning a light fixture: stand on the stepladder and remove the glass shade.
Step 3 of cleaning a light fixture: wash the glass shade in soapy water.
Step 4 of cleaning a light fixture: dry the glass shade with the cloth so there are no streaks.
Step 5 of cleaning a light fixture: refit the glass shade.
Step 6 of cleaning a light fixture: switch the light back on.

To clean a mattress you need a vacuum cleaner, mild detergent, a spray bottle, a soft brush and a clean cloth.
Cleaning a mattress takes 150 to 210 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a mattress: vacuum the mattress with the vacuum cleaner for 10 to 15 minutes.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of cleaning a mattress: mix the mild detergent into the spray bottle.
Step 3 of cleaning a mattress: spray the mattress from the spray bottle so the stains lift.
Step 4 of cleaning a mattress: scrub the stains with the soft brush.
Step 5 of cleaning a mattress: wipe the mattress with the clean cloth.
Step 6 of cleaning a mattress: leave the mattress to dry for 120 to 180 minutes until it is dry.

To caramelise onions you need an onion, butter, salt, a knife, a chopping board, a frying pan, a wooden spoon and a hob.
Caramelising onions takes 40 to 50 minutes.
Step 1 of caramelise onions: cut the onion on the chopping board with the knife, for 5 to 8 minutes.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of caramelise onions: heat the butter in the frying pan on the hob over low heat, for 3 to 5 minutes.
Step 3 of caramelise onions: add the onion to the frying pan once the butter has melted.
Step 4 of caramelise onions: stir the onion with the wooden spoon for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring often so it does not burn, until it is golden brown.
Step 5 of caramelise onions: season the onion with salt for 1 minute.

To cream butter and sugar you need butter, sugar, a measuring cup, a mixing bowl, an electric mixer and a spatula.
Creaming butter and sugar takes 35 to 45 minutes.
Step 1 of cream butter and sugar: leave the butter out at room temperature to soften for 30 to 40 minutes so it is easy to beat.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of cream butter and sugar: measure 100 grams of sugar with the measuring cup.
Step 3 of cream butter and sugar: pour the sugar into the mixing bowl with the softened butter.
Step 4 of cream butter and sugar: beat the butter and sugar with the electric mixer on medium speed for 3 to 5 minutes until pale and fluffy.
Step 5 of cream butter and sugar: scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with a spatula.

To make stock you need chicken bones, water, an onion, a pot, a stove and a strainer.
Making stock takes 90 to 120 minutes.
Step 1 of making stock: heat the water in the pot on the stove on high for 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 2 of making stock: add the chicken bones to the pot.
Step 3 of making stock: add the onion to the pot.
Step 4 of making stock: simmer the stock on low heat for 60 to 90 minutes until reduced, so the flavour develops.
Step 5 of making stock: strain the stock from the pot through the strainer.

To replace a bicycle chain you need a new chain, a chain breaker tool, a quick link and chain oil.
Replacing a bicycle chain takes 30 to 45 minutes.
Step 1 of replacing a bicycle chain: shift the chain onto the smallest rear sprocket.
Step 2 of replacing a bicycle chain: break the old chain with the chain breaker tool by pushing out a pin, without bending the pin.
Step 3 of replacing a bicycle chain: remove the old chain from the bike.
Step 4 of replacing a bicycle chain: thread the new chain through the derailleur and around the gears.
Step 5 of replacing a bicycle chain: join the two ends with the quick link, making sure it clicks fully into place.
Step 6 of replacing a bicycle chain: lubricate the new chain with chain oil so it moves freely.

To replace a toilet flapper you need a flapper, pliers and a sponge.
Replacing a toilet flapper takes 20 to 30 minutes.
Replacing a toilet flapper stops a toilet that keeps running.
Step 1 of replacing a toilet flapper: shut the water valve clockwise.
Step 2 of replacing a toilet flapper: flush the toilet to empty the tank.
Step 3 of replacing a toilet flapper: wipe the tank with the sponge.
Step 4 of replacing a toilet flapper: loosen the old flapper from the flush valve with the pliers.
Step 5 of replacing a toilet flapper: fasten the new flapper onto the flush valve.
Step 6 of replacing a toilet flapper: open the water valve until the tank fills.

To replace a zipper slider you need a new slider, pliers and a cloth.
Replacing a zipper slider takes 20 to 30 minutes.
Step 1 of replacing a zipper slider: pull the old slider off with the pliers, gently so the tape does not tear, which takes 5 to 10 minutes.
Step 2 of replacing a zipper slider: wipe the zipper teeth with the cloth for 2 to 3 minutes; you can skip this if the teeth are already clean.
Step 3 of replacing a zipper slider: slide the new slider onto the zipper teeth, which takes 3 to 5 minutes.
Step 4 of replacing a zipper slider: squeeze the new bottom stop shut with the pliers for 3 to 5 minutes so the slider stays on.
Step 5 of replacing a zipper slider: test the slider for 2 to 5 minutes and check that it runs smoothly up and down.

To clean a ceiling fan you need a duster, a microfibre cloth, a bucket and dish soap.
Cleaning a ceiling fan takes 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a ceiling fan: switch off the fan and wait until the blades have stopped.
Step 2 of cleaning a ceiling fan: dust the blades with the duster.
While step 2 runs, step 3 of cleaning a ceiling fan: mix dish soap into a bucket of warm water.
Step 4 of cleaning a ceiling fan: wipe each blade with the damp microfibre cloth until there is no dust left.

To clean a range hood filter you need a sink, hot water, dish soap, a sponge and a towel.
Cleaning a range hood filter takes 30 to 45 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a range hood filter: take the filter out of the hood, which takes about 5 minutes.
Step 2 of cleaning a range hood filter: soak the filter in hot water in the sink for 15 to 20 minutes so the grease loosens.
Step 3 of cleaning a range hood filter: scrub the filter with the sponge and dish soap for 5 to 10 minutes so the grease comes off.
Step 4 of cleaning a range hood filter: rinse the filter in hot water for 3 to 5 minutes.
Step 5 of cleaning a range hood filter: dry the filter with the towel for 3 to 5 minutes until the filter is dry.

To clean a washing machine you need a washing machine, white vinegar, a cloth and a brush.
Cleaning a washing machine takes 90 to 120 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a washing machine: pour 2 cups of white vinegar into the drum, and never mix it with bleach.
Step 2 of cleaning a washing machine: run an empty hot cycle at 60 degrees for 60 to 90 minutes.
While step 2 runs, step 3 of cleaning a washing machine: wipe the rubber door seal with the cloth to remove mould.
While step 2 runs, step 4 of cleaning a washing machine: scrub the detergent drawer with the brush.
Step 5 of cleaning a washing machine: leave the door open so the drum dries, which stops mould.

To blanch green beans you need green beans, water, a pot, a stove, a knife, a colander, a bowl and ice.
Blanching green beans takes 12 to 16 minutes.
Step 1 of blanching green beans: heat the water in the pot on the stove to a boil at 100 degrees for 5 to 8 minutes.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of blanching green beans: trim the green beans with the knife for 3 to 5 minutes.
Step 3 of blanching green beans: add the green beans to the boiling water in the pot for 2 to 3 minutes, until tender-crisp and bright green.
Step 4 of blanching green beans: drain the green beans in the colander for 1 minute.
Step 5 of blanching green beans: chill the green beans in a bowl of ice until cold, for 3 minutes, so they stop cooking.

To knead bread dough you need flour, water, yeast, salt, a bowl, a work surface and a cloth.
Kneading bread dough takes 90 to 120 minutes.
Step 1 of kneading bread dough: pour 300 millilitres of water at about 35 degrees into the bowl.
Step 2 of kneading bread dough: mix 500 grams of flour with the yeast and salt in the bowl.
Step 3 of kneading bread dough: knead the dough on the counter for 8 to 10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic, so the gluten forms.
Step 4 of kneading bread dough: cover the dough with a damp cloth so the surface stays moist.
Step 5 of kneading bread dough: let the dough rise for 60 to 90 minutes until it is doubled in size.

To temper chocolate you need chocolate, a knife, a saucepan, a heatproof bowl, a spoon and a thermometer.
Tempering chocolate takes 25 to 35 minutes.
While step 2 runs, step 1 of temper chocolate: chop 200 grams of the chocolate into small pieces with the knife.
Step 2 of temper chocolate: heat two thirds of the chocolate in the heatproof bowl over the saucepan of simmering water to 45 degrees, for 10 to 15 minutes, keeping water out of it so it does not seize.
Step 3 of temper chocolate: stir the remaining chopped chocolate into the melted chocolate with the spoon until it melts.
Step 4 of temper chocolate: cool the chocolate to 27 degrees, for 5 to 10 minutes, so the crystals set stable.
Step 5 of temper chocolate: measure the chocolate with the thermometer and check that it is glossy.

To whip cream you need heavy cream, sugar, a bowl, a whisk and a fridge.
Whipping cream takes 20 to 25 minutes.
Step 1 of whipping cream: chill the bowl in the fridge for 15 minutes so the cream whips faster.
Step 2 of whipping cream: pour 250 millilitres of heavy cream into the bowl.
Step 3 of whipping cream: add 25 grams of sugar to the bowl.
Step 4 of whipping cream: whisk the cream until it forms soft peaks, for 3 to 5 minutes, and stop before it turns grainy.

To fix a leaking shower valve you need a screwdriver, pliers, grease and a replacement cartridge.
Fixing a leaking shower valve takes 45 to 60 minutes.
Step 1 of fixing a leaking shower valve: shut off the water supply at the stop valve.
Step 2 of fixing a leaking shower valve: remove the handle with the screwdriver to loosen its screw.
Step 3 of fixing a leaking shower valve: lift out the old cartridge with the pliers.
Step 4 of fixing a leaking shower valve: coat the new cartridge with grease so the seal slides smoothly.
Step 5 of fixing a leaking shower valve: fit the new cartridge into the valve body.
Step 6 of fixing a leaking shower valve: fasten the handle back on with the screwdriver.
Step 7 of fixing a leaking shower valve: turn the water supply back on and check there is no drip.

To mend torn jeans you need jeans, scissors, a needle, thread and an iron.
Mending torn jeans takes 20 to 30 minutes.
Step 1 of mending torn jeans: trim the frayed threads with scissors.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of mending torn jeans: thread the needle.
Step 3 of mending torn jeans: sew the tear closed with the needle and thread, so the hole is shut, for 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 4 of mending torn jeans: tie a knot in the thread.
Step 5 of mending torn jeans: iron the mended seam so it lies flat.

To patch a wall crack you need a stiff brush, a damp cloth, wall filler, a putty knife, sandpaper, paint and a paint brush.
Patching a wall crack takes 60 to 90 minutes.
Step 1 of patching a wall crack: scrub inside the crack with the stiff brush for 5 to 10 minutes so the filler sticks.
Step 2 of patching a wall crack: wipe the crack with the damp cloth for 2 to 5 minutes until no dust is left.
Step 3 of patching a wall crack: spread the wall filler into the crack with the putty knife for 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 4 of patching a wall crack: once the filler is dry, sand it with sandpaper for 15 to 20 minutes.
Step 5 of patching a wall crack: paint over the crack with the paint brush, covering it with paint, for 30 to 40 minutes.

To clean a cast iron pan you need coarse salt, a sponge, paper towel, cooking oil and a stove.
Cleaning a cast iron pan takes 15 to 20 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a cast iron pan: scrub the pan with coarse salt and a sponge, without soap, so the seasoning is not stripped.
Step 2 of cleaning a cast iron pan: rinse the pan under hot water.
Step 3 of cleaning a cast iron pan: dry the pan with paper towel.
Step 4 of cleaning a cast iron pan: heat the pan on the stove on medium for 3 to 5 minutes so all the moisture is gone.
Step 5 of cleaning a cast iron pan: coat the warm pan with a thin layer of cooking oil to stop it rusting.

To clean a dishwasher you need a dishwasher, a dishwasher tablet, a sponge and a cloth.
Cleaning a dishwasher takes 85 to 115 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a dishwasher: scrub the dishwasher filter with the sponge so the spray arm stays clear, which takes 5 to 10 minutes.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of cleaning a dishwasher: wipe the door seal with the cloth, which takes 5 to 10 minutes.
Step 3 of cleaning a dishwasher: put one dishwasher tablet into the dishwasher, which takes 1 to 2 minutes.
Step 4 of cleaning a dishwasher: run the dishwasher on an empty normal cycle, which takes 80 to 100 minutes.

To clean a dryer lint trap you need a brush, warm water and a cloth.
Cleaning a dryer lint trap takes 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: pull the lint trap out of the dryer.
Step 2 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: scrub the lint trap with the brush so the lint comes loose.
Step 3 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: rinse the lint trap under warm water.
Step 4 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: wipe the lint trap with the cloth.
Step 5 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: let the lint trap dry for 5 to 10 minutes so no damp lint is left.
Step 6 of cleaning a dryer lint trap: insert the lint trap back into the dryer.

To beat egg whites you need an egg, a bowl and a whisk.
Beating egg whites takes 5 to 10 minutes.
Step 1 of beating egg whites: separate the egg, holding the bowl under it so the yolk stays out.
Step 2 of beating egg whites: beat the whites with the whisk at medium speed for 2 to 4 minutes until they are foamy.
Step 3 of beating egg whites: beat for 3 to 6 minutes until stiff peaks form, stopping before the whites look dry.

To shape pizza dough you need flour, water, a bowl, a spoon, a towel, olive oil, a rolling pin and a baking tray.
Shaping pizza dough takes 45 to 60 minutes.
Step 1 of shape pizza dough: mix the flour and water in the bowl with the spoon, which takes about 5 minutes.
Step 2 of shape pizza dough: cover the dough with the towel and leave it until it has risen, about 30 minutes.
Step 3 of shape pizza dough: knead the dough with a little olive oil for 10 minutes so it becomes elastic.
Step 4 of shape pizza dough: roll the dough flat with the rolling pin for about 5 minutes.
Step 5 of shape pizza dough: place the dough onto the baking tray, which takes about 2 minutes.

To thicken gravy you need butter, flour, stock, a saucepan, a hob and a whisk.
Thickening gravy takes 8 to 12 minutes.
Step 1 of thickening gravy: heat the butter in the saucepan on the hob over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Step 2 of thickening gravy: stir the flour into the butter with the whisk for 1 minute.
Step 3 of thickening gravy: cook the flour on the hob for 1 to 2 minutes until it smells nutty, so it does not taste floury.
Step 4 of thickening gravy: pour the stock into the saucepan slowly for 1 minute.
Step 5 of thickening gravy: simmer the gravy on the hob for 3 to 5 minutes until it is thick and glossy.

To adjust bicycle brakes you need a bicycle and an allen key.
Adjusting bicycle brakes takes 15 to 25 minutes.
Step 1 of adjusting bicycle brakes: loosen the brake cable bolt with the allen key.
Step 2 of adjusting bicycle brakes: pull the brake cable until it is taut, to remove the slack.
Step 3 of adjusting bicycle brakes: fasten the brake cable bolt again with the allen key, without overtightening it.
Step 4 of adjusting bicycle brakes: squeeze the brake lever to check the pads touch the rim.
Step 5 of adjusting bicycle brakes: spin the wheel to check it turns freely.

To fix bicycle gear shifting you need a bicycle, a rag and a hex key.
Fixing bicycle gear shifting takes 30 to 45 minutes.
Step 1 of fixing bicycle gear shifting: wipe the chain with the rag, which can be skipped if you are short on time.
Step 2 of fixing bicycle gear shifting: loosen the cable bolt with the hex key (a multitool with the right bit also works).
Step 3 of fixing bicycle gear shifting: pull the cable taut by hand so the derailleur sits in place.
Step 4 of fixing bicycle gear shifting: tighten the cable bolt with the hex key, but not too tight.
Step 5 of fixing bicycle gear shifting: test the gears and check that they shift smoothly.

To fix a running toilet you need a cloth and pliers.
Fixing a running toilet takes 15 to 30 minutes.
Step 1 of fix a running toilet: shut off the water valve behind the toilet to stop water flow, for 1 minute.
Step 2 of fix a running toilet: flush the toilet to empty the tank, for 2 to 5 minutes.
While step 2 runs, step 3 of fix a running toilet: wipe the flapper seat clean with the cloth.
Step 4 of fix a running toilet: adjust the flapper chain with the pliers so it has a little slack, for 3 to 5 minutes; a chain that is too tight keeps the flapper open.
Step 5 of fix a running toilet: open the water valve again and wait until the tank stops refilling, for 1 minute.

To patch a bicycle inner tube you need a tyre lever, a bowl of water, sandpaper, glue, a rubber patch and a pump.
Patching a bicycle inner tube takes 30 to 40 minutes.
Step 1 of patching a bicycle inner tube: loosen the tyre with the tyre lever.
Step 2 of patching a bicycle inner tube: submerge the inner tube in the bowl of water to find the hole.
Step 3 of patching a bicycle inner tube: scrub the inner tube with sandpaper so the glue sticks.
Step 4 of patching a bicycle inner tube: coat the inner tube with glue.
Step 5 of patching a bicycle inner tube: press the rubber patch onto the hole.
Step 6 of patching a bicycle inner tube: pump the inner tube until it is firm.

To clean baseboards you need a vacuum cleaner, a bucket, dish soap, a sponge and a dry cloth.
Cleaning baseboards takes 20 to 30 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning baseboards: vacuum the baseboards with the vacuum cleaner to remove dust.
While step 1 runs, step 2 of cleaning baseboards: mix dish soap into the bucket of warm water.
Step 3 of cleaning baseboards: scrub the baseboards with the sponge to lift dirt.
Step 4 of cleaning baseboards: wipe the baseboards with the dry cloth so they are dry.

To clean a sofa you need a sofa, a vacuum cleaner, an upholstery brush, an upholstery cleaner, a cloth and a fan.
Cleaning a sofa takes 45 to 60 minutes.
Step 1 of cleaning a sofa: vacuum the sofa with the vacuum cleaner for 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 2 of cleaning a sofa: scrub the sofa with the upholstery brush and upholstery cleaner for 15 to 20 minutes so the dirt lifts, but do not let the fabric get too wet.
Step 3 of cleaning a sofa: wipe the sofa with a cloth for 10 to 15 minutes so the cleaner is removed.

To clean a toaster you need a brush and a cloth.
Cleaning a toaster takes 10 to 15 minutes.

Step 2 of cleaning a toaster: empty the crumb tray.
Step 3 of cleaning a toaster: brush the crumbs out of the slots with a small brush until the slots are clear.
Step 4 of cleaning a toaster: wipe the outside of the toaster with a damp cloth, keeping water out of the slots.
Step 5 of cleaning a toaster: slide the crumb tray back in.
Step 6 of cleaning a toaster: plug the toaster back in.

To braise beef short ribs you need short ribs, salt, a dutch oven, beef stock, a lid and an oven.
Braising beef short ribs takes 180 to 210 minutes.
Step 1 of braise beef short ribs: heat the oven to 160 degrees for 10 minutes.

Step 4 of braise beef short ribs: pour the beef stock into the dutch oven.

To deglaze a pan you need a pan, wine, a wooden spoon, a stove and salt.

To marinate chicken you need chicken, olive oil, a lemon, salt, a bowl and a fridge.

Step 4 of marinate chicken: turn the chicken over in the bowl.
Step 5 of marinate chicken: chill the chicken in the fridge at 4 degrees for 120 to 240 minutes so the flavour soaks in.

To fix a jammed zipper you need a zipper, a cotton swab, a pencil and pliers.

Step 1 of fixing a jammed zipper: wipe the teeth clean with the cotton swab, for 2 to 3 minutes, so debris is removed.
Step 2 of fixing a jammed zipper: rub the teeth with the pencil so the slider slides freely, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Step 3 of fixing a jammed zipper: grip the slider with the pliers for about 1 minute, taking care not to tear the fabric.
Step 4 of fixing a jammed zipper: move the slider up and down 5 times, for 2 to 4 minutes, until it moves freely.

To replace a kitchen faucet cartridge you need a replacement cartridge, a screwdriver, an adjustable wrench and plumber's grease.

Step 1 of replacing a kitchen faucet cartridge: shut off the water valve under the sink.

Step 5 of replacing a kitchen faucet cartridge: install the replacement cartridge.
Step 6 of replacing a kitchen faucet cartridge: fasten the handle back on with the screwdriver.
Step 7 of replacing a kitchen faucet cartridge: open the water valve slowly and check that the faucet no longer drips.

To sew a loose seam you need thread, a needle and scissors.

Step 1 of sewing a loose seam: cut a length of thread with the scissors, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Step 2 of sewing a loose seam: thread the needle, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Step 3 of sewing a loose seam: stitch the seam closed with the needle and thread until the seam is firm, for 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 4 of sewing a loose seam: tie the thread in a knot at the end, for 1 minute.
Step 5 of sewing a loose seam: cut the thread off close to the knot with the scissors, for 1 minute.
